summary: Jan-2026 major update batch tested end-to-end: health, coverage-by-pincode (in-zone + graceful unresolved + bad-pin), admin trend-products (auth, list, persist, patch), admin image-gallery (search, GET, PUT round-trip with alt keywords), house_categories_only site-setting round-trip, and COD order placement latency + referral fields. 14/15 backend tests pass, 1 skipped (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY over budget — Gemini path can't be exercised in this env). All 5 frontend acceptance points verified live.

minor.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is over budget (Current cost: 25.46, Max: 25.44) — LiteLLM returns RateLimitError → endpoint returns 502. Wiring is correct (route, auth, generator, model=gemini-2.5-flash all resolve), but the LLM path itself is unreachable until the key budget is topped up. Test skips gracefully.

issues: Console flooded with 'Encountered two children with the same key ba_<hash>' React warnings — hundreds per page load. Coming from a list rendered with non-unique `ba_...` keys (looks like a beauty-analytics / body-attributes tracker). Non-blocking but pollutes DevTools and is a latent duplication risk.

action_items: Top up EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget so the Gemini-powered trend-product generator can actually be exercised. Route/service wiring is correct — retest generate → persist → patch after top-up.

Track down the source of duplicate React keys (ba_f31b5bcb, ba_c8682ccf, ba_ecec06d3, ba_aa005e19, ba_b7be2f3f, ...) — likely a `.map` over an array where two items share the same id. Grep for `key={.*ba_` or a tracker rendering pixel elements.
critical_code_review_comments: trend_products.py POST /admin/trend-products/generate wraps all non-HTTPException failures in a 502 with `f'Generator error: {exc}'`. This includes rate-limit and budget errors — fine for opaque failures, but the emergent-ingress swallows the JSON body and shows a generic HTML 502 page to browsers, so admins won't see the real reason (budget exceeded). Consider surfacing rate-limit / budget errors as 429 with `{'reason':'llm_budget_exceeded'}` so the admin UI can render actionable copy.

OrderCreate.amount is server-recomputed via cart/validate (good — prevents tampering), but the mismatch error message returns raw ₹ values (`server: ₹1014.0, sent: ₹850.0`). This is customer-facing on 400; consider truncating decimals and phrasing without server-side numbers to avoid confusion.

trend_product_generator.py `chat.send_message` has no timeout wrapper — a slow Gemini call can pin an event-loop worker for up to LiteLLM's internal timeout. The public ingress will 502 at ~55s regardless. Consider `asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=45)` inside the generator so we return a clean 504 to the admin before ingress kills the connection.
